applies_why: The judge text resolves D5 vs C5 by assessing whether CR2 G answered the challenger's almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows and whether the sign's sense remains open, which is the row-by-row collision K-C governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' had to be read either as requiring overall chain-footing comparison rather than row-by-row testing, or as permitting row checks to decide the link; I read it as requiring overall chain-footing comparison.
why: The judge calls D5 underdetermined from answered rows and an open sign-sense without weighing the competing chains by footing, so it does the verse-by-verse testing K-C forbids.
